title: feat(build-rs): trim-paths inputs
body:
### What does this PR try to resolve?

Support parsing trim-paths env vars in `build-rs`

Also, to make the API more reasonable, 

* Cargo now set `CARGO_TRIM_PATHS_{SCOPE,REMAP}` unconditionally
* The default value is `"none"` and no longer ambiguous `"unset"`. The reason is that most of other profile settings has a default value rather than a `null` like value.

### How to test and review this PR?

Test of `build-rs` is a bit ugly.
Those will look better once stabilized.
